name: core/group-offline-events
description: Group changes made while a member is offline are queued (create/invite, kick, disband, join review only; role changes and renames are not) and delivered after the member's next login. A queued grp_sync whose group no longer has the member is dropped silently. Only acked events stop being replayed.

steps.note: C must have logged in once before it can be added to a group
queues event 3: grp_disband for gone; event 2 is now stale
expect grp_sync(kept, eventId 1) and grp_disband(gone, eventId 3); event 2 is dropped
only the un-acked grp_disband (eventId 3) is replayed
